class PrerequisiteReason association PrerequisiteReason { Course successor; Course prerequisite; }

PrerequisiteReason * sucReason -- 1 successor CourseA Course called successor has some PrerequisiteReasons called sucReason. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.A PrerequisiteReason called sucReason has A Course called successor. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Course called successor.When a PrerequisiteReason is created, its Course must be assigned. When a PrerequisiteReason is deleted, its Course is not deleted and its list of PrerequisiteReasons is decreased. When a Course is deleted, its PrerequisiteReasons are not deleted. They are assigned to another Course.
